description: The jabberwock's STABLE FEATURE IDENTITY (graph-native): the eye proposes ephemeral Regions; persistent Feature nodes own identity, matched each frame to the salient Regions by PREDICTED POSITION (predict(F)=pos+vel) + value and updated IN PLACE (feature_correspond), born when unmatched (feature_birth), and COASTED/retained when unrealised (feature_miss — never die). Generalises: kind=mover (|vel|>1) / meter (value changes in place) / static / avatar. Beats the region churn — identity, gaps, roles live on durable Features. Region—realises→Feature.
